descripcion: At C2 feedback separates the observation from its interpretation explicitly, offering the interpretation as a hypothesis the other person can confirm or correct — rather than asserting it as fact — which turns feedback into a conversation instead of a verdict.

filas: The last three drafts came in after the deadline.
My guess is the scope keeps growing after we start — but tell me if that's off.
Does that match what's happening on your end?

ejemplos.texto: The last three drafts came in after the deadline. My guess is the scope keeps growing partway through — does that match what's happening?
I noticed you went quiet in that meeting. I don't know why, and I'd rather ask than assume.
That's my read on it, but you're closer to it than I am.

notas: Offering the interpretation as a hypothesis (my guess is) rather than a fact keeps the recipient's own account genuinely open, not just performed as open.
Explicitly checking (does that match?) turns the feedback into a two-way exchange rather than a one-way verdict.
You're closer to it than I am hands genuine authority back to the recipient about their own situation.

contraste.es: Spanish can frame an interpretation as tentative (a lo mejor me equivoco, pero…), so the move exists. English uses a small set of fixed phrases for it (my reading is…, tell me if I've got this wrong) that are worth learning as units.
contraste.de: German has exact equivalents: wenn ich das richtig verstehe (if I've understood this correctly) and korrigieren Sie mich, wenn ich falsch liege (correct me if I'm wrong). The move therefore transfers directly.
contraste.it: Correggimi se sbaglio corresponds exactly to correct me if I'm wrong, so offering an interpretation as a hypothesis transfers directly. My reading is… is a useful additional formula.
contraste.fr: Corrigez-moi si je me trompe corresponds exactly to correct me if I'm wrong, so the move transfers directly. My reading is… is a useful additional formula.
contraste.pt: Corrige-me se estiver enganado corresponds exactly to correct me if I'm wrong, so the move transfers directly. My reading is… is a useful additional formula.

errores: Stating an interpretation as fact rather than as a checkable hypothesis.
Asking a checking question rhetorically, without genuine openness to being told the interpretation is wrong.
Skipping the observation and going straight to interpretation, so there's nothing concrete to check against.

redemittel.expresion: My guess is…, but tell me if that's off.

traducciones.es: Mi impresión es…, pero decime si me equivoco.
traducciones.de: Mein Eindruck ist…, aber sag mir, wenn ich danebenliege.
traducciones.fr: Mon impression est…, mais dis-moi si je me trompe.
traducciones.it: La mia impressione è…, ma dimmi se sbaglio.
traducciones.pt: A minha impressão é…, mas diz-me se estiver enganado/a.

redemittel.expresion: Does that match what's happening on your end?

traducciones.es: ¿Eso coincide con lo que está pasando de tu lado?
traducciones.de: Entspricht das dem, was bei euch passiert?
traducciones.fr: Est-ce que cela correspond à ce qui se passe de votre côté ?
traducciones.it: Corrisponde a ciò che sta succedendo da voi?
traducciones.pt: Isso corresponde ao que está a acontecer do vosso lado?

redemittel.expresion: I noticed…, and I don't know why.

traducciones.es: Noté…, y no sé por qué.
traducciones.de: Mir ist… aufgefallen, und ich weiß nicht warum.
traducciones.fr: J’ai remarqué…, et je ne sais pas pourquoi.
traducciones.it: Ho notato…, e non so perché.
traducciones.pt: Reparei em…, e não sei porquê.

redemittel.expresion: That's my read on it, but you're closer to it than I am.

traducciones.es: Esa es mi lectura, pero vos estás más cerca del tema que yo.
traducciones.de: So sehe ich das, aber du bist näher dran als ich.
traducciones.fr: C’est ma lecture, mais tu es plus proche du sujet que moi.
traducciones.it: Questa è la mia lettura, ma tu sei più vicino/a alla questione di me.
traducciones.pt: Essa é a minha leitura, mas tu estás mais próximo/a do assunto do que eu.

redemittel.expresion: Correct me if I've got this wrong.

traducciones.de: Korrigiere mich, wenn ich das falsch verstanden habe.

redemittel.expresion: What's your take on why that happened?

traducciones.es: ¿Cuál es tu impresión de por qué pasó eso?
traducciones.de: Wie erklärst du dir, warum das passiert ist?
traducciones.fr: Selon toi, pourquoi cela s’est-il produit ?
traducciones.it: Qual è la tua lettura del perché sia successo?
traducciones.pt: Qual é a tua leitura sobre porque é que isso aconteceu?

autochequeo: Is the observation stated separately from the interpretation?
Is the interpretation offered as a checkable hypothesis, not a fact?
Is the checking question genuinely open, not rhetorical?
Does the recipient's account remain genuinely possible to differ?
Is there a concrete observation underlying the feedback?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on whether the observation and interpretation are kept separate, and whether the interpretation is offered as a genuine hypothesis. Do not rewrite the text.
